issues.title: Ladder AI now completes a bounded full-game simulator loop
issues.detail: The policy now maintains gas and supply, adds production and high-tech structures, researches upgrades, trains a mixed army, scouts, responds to a pressure wave, uses compact attack-move and visible-target focus-fire, and completes enemy elimination for seeds 42, 7, and 99 without dispatch errors.
issues.nextAction: Keep simulator capability and native SC2 economy/timing claims separate; use the approved Computer-ally runtime path for native balance validation.

issues.title: Full CMRE catalog source binding is not present in this checkout
issues.detail: The historical full-source catalog scan recorded 35,404 declarations, but this checkout has no src/config/local.sources.json and no additional CMRE source root was found. The current reproducible catalog covers owned project packages plus the Vibe kernel and records 23,019 declarations with zero parser errors.
issues.nextAction: Restore the approved local CMRE source binding and rerun discover_function_catalog.mjs over the registered source plus owned packages before making a new full-source catalog claim.

issues.title: Native P2 runtime topology cleared by single-client Computer path
issues.detail: The old two-Participant JoinGame topology remained blocked, but it is not the selected runtime topology. Fresh v13 ApiMinimal validation proves P1 as Participant and P2 as Computer in the map roster, native P2 initialization, P1 chat commands forwarded to P2-owned orders, Bank acknowledgements, three P2-to-P1 UIDisplayMessage signal records, P2 state deltas, native replay output, and zero same-window ScriptErrors.
issues.nextAction: Keep the two-Participant probe as historical blocked evidence; use the single-client Computer-ally topology for future native map validation.

issues.title: SC2 installation repair marker cleared for single-client runtime
issues.detail: Older approved launcher attempts on ports 5230 and 5221 crashed before API listen with e_fileCorruptRepairable and EEV_REPAIR_CONTAINER. After the local reinstall, a fresh approved launcher on port 5310 reached API ready, CreateGame/JoinGame, and completed the Ability VM without a ScriptError. The remaining P2 native blocker is participant topology, not this installation marker.
issues.nextAction: Keep the installation issue resolved and continue the two-client native P2 probe; require participant-owned player_id=2 before claiming native actions.

issues.title: Dead of Night Objects has no native P1/P2 units
issues.detail: The source map contains one ACHeroSpawnPlacement for P1 at (85,94) and one for P2 at (76,103), but no native P1/P2 ObjectUnit force. The strict map-derived replay therefore injects zero units and intentionally makes no P2 movement/combat claim. Native P2 initialization, P1 commands, P2-owned state changes, acknowledgements, and signals are proven separately by the staged single-client Computer-ally runtime path.
issues.nextAction: Keep the strict map-derived replay free of fixture units; use the staged runtime replay for P2 action evidence and retain this limitation when presenting source-map-only projection results.

issues.title: Browser runtime console has no live SC2 invoke evidence yet
issues.detail: Resolved by a fresh approved launcher window on port 5192. The WebUI resumed session repl_32f2ed98ec89, completed a real vibe.test.ping function.invoke, then completed the group Debug VM with 11 instructions and final has_behavior=true.
issues.nextAction: Keep future browser traces separate from native strategy evidence and rerun the same-window ScriptError gate after runtime changes.

issues.title: Fresh restarted SC2 Debug VM rerun passed
issues.detail: After releasing the stale 5201 lease, a fresh approved launcher window on port 5194 completed CreateGame/JoinGame and the full 11-instruction group VM against the current staged map. This confirms the typed Debug VM runtime path; it is intentionally separate from native P2 strategy acceptance.
issues.nextAction: Keep the native P2 gather/train/move/attack blocker open until a participant-owned P2 runtime window passes without debug injection.

issues.title: Post-reinstall Ability VM passed in a fresh SC2 window
issues.detail: The approved launcher on port 5310 loaded the freshly repacked map. The VM created three real Marines, added Stimpack to each, and independently queried each unit with has_ability=true. All 15 VM instructions passed and the same-window ScriptError scan found zero new errors.
issues.nextAction: Use this VM path for dynamic function debugging; keep debug injection evidence separate from native P2 strategy acceptance.

issues.title: Ladder simulator uses a bounded initial resource fixture
issues.detail: The complete ladder-style simulator game starts with 2600 minerals and 800 vespene so the deterministic 60-loop gather cadence covers the full technology and victory loop within the bounded test budget. This proves strategy capability and victory closure, but it is not a native SC2 balance or timing claim.
issues.nextAction: Keep this caveat attached to simulator evidence; only replace the fixture with native economy timing after the two-client runtime P2 topology gate is available.

issues.title: Dual-client P2 JoinGame handshake still does not return a participant
issues.detail: Two fresh SC2 processes launched through the approved launcher passed independent Ping. P1 completed CreateGame, and both clients submitted the reference-shaped 1v1 Portconfig with server ports 5500/5501 and guest client ports 5502/5503. P1 JoinGame and P2 JoinGame then remained in the SC2 peer handshake until timeout; no P2 player_id=2 and no P1/P2 participant roster appeared in GameInfo. This run provides no native P2 action evidence.
issues.nextAction: Retain this failed dual-Participant handshake as historical evidence; use the single-client Computer-ally topology for acceptance.

issues.title: Reference-shaped dual-client JoinGame remains blocked after launcher isolation fixes
issues.detail: Four fresh approved-launcher variants reached independent API readiness and P1 CreateGame success. Omitting host_ip, matching python-sc2 participant setup, using distinct per-client temp directories, adding explicit dataDir, and testing realtime=True did not produce player_id=2 or a P1/P2 participant roster. The realtime variant closed P1's websocket during JoinGame. No P2 native action or native replay was claimed.
issues.nextAction: Reproduce the complete python-sc2 multi-process launch contract or identify a runtime configuration that exposes a real second Participant; require player_id=2 and GameInfo roster before native task actions.

issues.title: Independent P1/P2 retry rejected by protected runtime lease
issues.detail: The approved primary launcher on API port 5620 exited with SC2_RUNTIME_BUSY before SC2 launch. Existing lease runtimePid=19648, port=5600, ownerPid=40128, state=keepalive, session=cmre_alenger-20260802-223507-9f170899. The secondary port 5621 was not attempted because no independent P1 anchor was created.
issues.nextAction: After the protected lease is released by its owner, rerun the approved primary 5620 plus secondary 5621 launcher window and require player_id=2, reciprocal alliance roster, RequestStep frame deltas, P2-owned native actions, native replay, and same-window ScriptError evidence.

issues.title: Debug VM runtime capability matrix passed in a fresh window
issues.detail: A fresh approved launcher window on port 5640 completed the hot-loaded 47-instruction capability VM after explicit CreateGame/JoinGame and 15 seconds of RequestStep initialization. The live VM read back a cross-unit ability, vitals, Catalog values, training reference, and successful visual handler responses with zero same-window ScriptErrors.
issues.nextAction: Use the hot-loaded Debug VM for subsequent dynamic function experiments; keep visual screenshot proof and native P2 topology as separate gates.

issues.title: Debug VM visual mutation lacks screenshot-level proof
issues.detail: The live VM returned applied=true for model variation, scale, tint, and opacity. A 2560x1440 screenshot was captured from the 5640 window, but pixel inspection found nonblack=0 and nontransparent=0 because ApiMinimal produced a headless/minimized frame. The current claim is handler/application success, not confirmed on-screen presentation.
issues.nextAction: Add a screenshot or equivalent runtime visual assertion around the mutated Marine before promoting visual presentation to PASS.

issues.title: All 15 CMRE cooperative maps complete in the full-game simulator matrix
issues.detail: The final seed-42 matrix completed all 15 extracted CMRE cooperative maps. Each run reached enemy_elimination with victory=true, zero remaining enemy units, empty error_breakdown, and no deadlock, command storm, friendly-fire rejection, or hidden-state violation. Each map emitted a JSONL replay, state-driven-player.html, and run-summary.json.
issues.nextAction: Keep this result labeled simulator-only; native SC2 P2 topology remains a separate blocked runtime gate.

issues.title: Corrected v8 native P2 runtime was waiting on an existing KeepAlive lease
issues.detail: The v8 attempt was blocked by an existing KeepAlive lease. The lease was released for the v11 rerun, and the approved single-client API path completed the native P2 Computer probe with Bank, replay, and ScriptError evidence.
issues.nextAction: Use the lease-aware approved launcher flow for subsequent runs.

issues.title: DirectMap API bootstrap crashes before the native P2 probe can attach
issues.detail: The approved DirectMap+API launcher staged the corrected map and launched SC2Switcher, but SC2_x64 exited before API listen with ACCESS_VIOLATION (0xC0000005). No CreateGame, JoinGame, P2 roster, native replay, or strategy action was sent.
issues.nextAction: Repair or replace the approved SC2Switcher direct-map API bootstrap, then rerun with the same staged map and require API listen before any native P2 claim.

issues.title: DirectMap without API has no P2 Computer roster or chat event
issues.detail: A fresh approved DirectMap window reached runtime_listener_ready, initialization_complete, P1/P2 readiness markers, and zero same-window ScriptErrors. The map reported PlayerType(2)=0 with ally_not_ready_reason=p2_not_computer, and an ASCII clipboard !ally status input produced no ChatMessage event or fallback command key.
issues.nextAction: Use a working API/lobby topology that supplies P1 Participant plus P2 Computer; do not treat PlayerType 0 DirectMap initialization or listener readiness as native ally acceptance.

issues.title: Generic CMRE maps lacked the native P2 Computer glue and map-correct replay metadata
issues.detail: The non-Dead-of-Night launcher path selected generic glue but did not define the P2 Computer initialization or P1 !ally entry points, and the live runner used fixed Dead of Night metadata in replay headers. Generic glue now owns the same P2 native initialization and P1-only command contract, missing map-local Vibe kernels use the registered shared kernel, and the runner resolves metadata from the runtime map name through cmre_map_catalog.
issues.nextAction: Keep generic-map runtime evidence separate from Dead of Night mission-specific strategy claims; validate additional maps through the same approved Computer-ally topology.

issues.title: HTML replay is map-accurate projection, not native SC2 rendering
issues.detail: The single-file player now embeds each source Minimap.tga, projects all extracted ObjectUnits into its non-black content rectangle, renders dynamic P1/P2/enemy coordinates, and uses project-owned Catalog CFootprint geometry where exact rows are available. Missing base-game/CASC icons remain explicitly unavailable rather than fabricated. It still cannot reproduce SC2 3D unit models, animation, lighting, fog of war, attack effects, or native camera/UI behavior.
issues.nextAction: Keep native .SC2Replay as the only one-to-one renderer. Future HTML work is limited to resolvable source model/icon assets and replay-derived combat/death markers; do not present unavailable CASC assets or inferred geometry as exact.

issues.title: 克哈裂痕 full-game push retried unreachable structure-footprint units
issues.detail: The first 64-enemy full-game run reached enemy elimination but generated sim_error:unreachable retries for two P2 units: one trained on a FactoryTechLab footprint and one left beside the P1 base structure.
